title: Adapt parameter proposals using progress before success appears
hypothesis: Sequential parameter proposals guided by task progress can exploit weak structures more efficiently than independent local and global draws.

prediction.against: budget-matched independent parameter search on baseline61_gen0_cand1_a0 and baseline61_gen0_cand2_a1
prediction.rationale: This tests adaptive proposal generation, not the search-versus-imitation comparison of D-005 or candidate pooling of D-007; eight points would justify a larger exploration-lane replacement pilot.

protocol.command: gpu run -- python scripts/benchmark_fitting.py --config config/two_lane_search.yaml --research-mode adaptive-progress-search --structures baseline61_gen0_cand1_a0 baseline61_gen0_cand2_a1 --search-seeds 3030 3031 --probe-seed 3032 --probe-cases 5 --confirmation-seed 3033 --confirmation-cases 50 --candidates-per-arm 24 --adaptive-batches 8 8 8 --bc-steps 0 --no-promotion --require-approval --stop-gpu-on-exit
code_changes: scripts/benchmark_fitting.py: add the declared research-mode flags, approval gate, and remote shutdown handling; load frozen structures and parameter ranges rather than regenerate them.

scripts/benchmark_fitting.py: compare original plus 23 independent draws against 24 sequential candidates including the original; adaptive batches update a diagonal proposal from the top quarter ranked by success, then signed goal progress, retaining 20% global exploration.
scripts/benchmark_fitting.py: use identical success-then-progress finalist selection in both arms, count invalid candidates against budget, and keep imitation disabled.
scripts/benchmark_fitting.py: generate disjoint development-only manifests and report paired confirmation intervals by placement and structure-search-seed cell.

falsified_by: The upper 95% paired interval is below +0.08; an interval containing zero is inconclusive about improvement. A positive estimate on these two structures alone does not establish general lane replacement.
